release_notes: **macOS port**: full native support — per-user `~/Library/Application Support/ThetaPrime` data root, a LaunchAgent-based backend service (replacing an earlier LaunchDaemon that had no login session and couldn't reach the user's unlocked Keychain), a `.pkg` installer, and a pywebview/pystray desktop shell with a working menu-bar tray icon, reaching feature parity with the Windows desktop app. Hardware-confirmed through a full fresh-install retest (fresh `.pkg`, no leftover LaunchAgent or data dir). **Trade Status modal shows book bid/offer for stale legs**: Breeze/Kite/Dhan legs with no live tick (`price_source "bs"`) can sit on a frozen LTP for minutes while the broker's book keeps moving. The modal now fetches bid/offer for just the stale legs and tags them "(book mid)". Display-only — P&L still uses the existing price. RELIANCE DSRD directional-condor strategy spec added to the strategy library. Navbar Settings moved from a dropdown item to a standalone gear icon. **macOS blank window on launch and tray Quit not exiting**: several distinct root causes found and fixed during hardware testing — WKWebView blocking `http://127.0.0.1` without an explicit ATS exception; that exception getting desynced from Nuitka's ad-hoc code signature once `Info.plist` was patched after signing (now re-signed afterward); pystray making AppKit calls off the main thread on macOS (left tray clicks silently dead); `NSApplication.terminate_` routing back through pywebview's own close-veto logic meant for minimize-to-tray (replaced with `os._exit(0)` on darwin, safe since shell.py holds no state of its own); and a cold-start race where the window could open and fail to load during the backend's first-launch Keychain prompts, with no retry (fixed with a one-time health-check-and-reload). **macOS backend service switched from LaunchDaemon to LaunchAgent**: a root LaunchDaemon has no GUI/login session and can't access the user's unlocked Keychain, which `storage.py`'s credential storage needs — not a permissions issue, categorically impossible for a root daemon. LaunchAgent logs and `DATA_ROOT` also moved to per-user paths instead of root-owned ones under the old LaunchDaemon design. `launchd_setup.sh` failures are now surfaced instead of silently swallowed, and `licensing.get_fingerprint()` no longer crashes on macOS (no `winreg` analog). Stale "FAILED" badge on strategy cards now refreshes instead of sticking after the next run. Dropped an unintended green active-fill from the Settings gear icon-button.
